Use AssetDescription to capture specific details like "Transit (Worldwide)" or "Storage (Named Location)". - Coverage Classification: - Transit Risks: Covers goods while in transit (e.g., Vessel, Air, Truck). - Storage Risks: Covers goods while in storage (e.g., Warehouse). - General Cargo: Standard marine cargo coverage.

InsurancePolicyCoverage: High-level coverage groupings (e.g., "Transit Risks", "Storage Risks"). 6. InsurancePolicyCoverageLineitem: Specific limits and deductibles for each coverage scope.
